caption: The drawing depicts a wooden dresser with three drawers, each adorned with a repeating pattern of dark, ornate, floral and geometric designs. The dresser is rendered in shades of brown, with the main structure of the dresser appearing in a medium wood tone, while the decorative patterns on the drawer fronts and the sides are in a much darker brown or blackish color. Each drawer has a single round knob located in the center. The side panels of the dresser feature vertical design elements that resemble stylized plant or leaf motifs in the same dark color as the patterns on the drawers. The dresser has simple, rectangular legs and is set against a beige background. The artist's name, "FLORENCE V. NEAL", is inscribed in small, neat lettering in the bottom right corner.
title: Chest of Drawers
